The '''62nd [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film and television for 2004, were held on January 16, 2005.<ref>{{cite news|last1=LaSalle|first1=Mick|title='Sideways' wins expected Golden Globe; 'Aviator' success makes Oscar handicappers scratch heads|url=http://www.sfgate.com/entertainment/article/Sideways-wins-expected-Golden-Globe-Aviator-2704556.php|access-date=10 January 2018|work=[[San Francisco Chronicle]]|date=17 January 2005|archive-date=December 28, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171228232100/http://www.sfgate.com/entertainment/article/Sideways-wins-expected-Golden-Globe-Aviator-2704556.php|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Welkos|first1=Robert|last2=King|first2=Susan|title=A Golden glow|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2005-jan-17-et-ggmain17-story.html|access-date=10 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=17 January 2005|archive-date=December 9, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151209155255/http://articles.latimes.com/2005/jan/17/entertainment/et-ggmain17|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=DiCaprio, Foxx, Swank, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180111164911/https://www.npr.org/templates/story/story.php?storyId=4455685|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Karger|first1=Dave|last2=Cruz|first2=Clarissa|last3=Weiner|first3=Allison|title=EW recaps the Golden Globes|url=https://ew.com/article/2005/01/24/ew-recaps-golden-globes/|website=Entertainment Weekly|access-date=10 January 2018|date=24 January 2005|archive-date=April 18, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190418200753/https://ew.com/article/2005/01/24/ew-recaps-golden-globes/|url-status=live}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 13, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180110234337/http://variety.com/2004/film/awards/globes-noms-all-about-booze-and-hughes-1117914901/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Aviator 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190627033421/https://usatoday30.usatoday.com/life/movies/movieawards/goldenglobes/2004-12-13-nominee-list_x.htm|url-status=live}}</ref>

''[[Sideways]]'' received the most nominations (7). ''[[The Aviator (2004 film)|The Aviator]]'' won the most awards, with 3 (including Best Motion Picture – Drama). ''[[Finding Neverland (film)|Finding Neverland]]'' had the most nominations (5) without a single win.
